- Risk mitigation

- Fast-paced environment  
- Highly motivated, collaborative  
- Enterprise-class applications  
- IT/Digital experience (8+ years)  
- TPM (Technical Program/Product/Project Manager) experience (4+ years)  
- Full lifecycle / full cycle program leadership
